results.flow_input_to_sink: Caller-supplied `from`, `to` (non-zero, non-protocol EOA address with `to.code.length == 0`), `tokenId`, and `msg.sender` reach `ERC721._update` storage mutations (`_balances`, `_owners[tokenId] = to`, `_tokenApprovals[tokenId] = address(0)`) and the `Transfer(from, to, tokenId)` event before `ERC721Utils.checkOnERC721Received` exits without an external call.
results.flow_security_relevance: Transfers bearer ownership of a Raffle ticket across any raffle lifecycle state (`Active`, `Drawing`, `NftWon`, `CashWon`, `Refunding`), directly reassigning who is authorized to pass the `ownerOf(ticketId) == msg.sender` check in `redeemWinningTicket` or `refundTickets`.
results.flow_summary: An authorized caller (current ticket owner, token-approved address, or operator approved via `isApprovedForAll`) calls the 3-argument `ERC721.safeTransferFrom(from, to, tokenId)` to transfer a raffle ticket to an EOA (or codeless address) `to`. The call delegates to the 4-argument `safeTransferFrom` with empty bytes `""` and then `transferFrom`, passes the zero-address check and `Raffle._update`'s `_isProtocolDestination` check (including staticcall to `RaffleFactory.raffleImplementation()`), verifies authorization and ownership in `ERC721._update` and `ERC721.transferFrom`, clears per-token approvals, updates `_balances` and `_owners[tokenId] = to`, emits `Transfer`, and skips the `onERC721Received` callback because `to.code.length == 0`.
results.flow_terminal_action: Mutates ERC-721 ownership state (`_owners[tokenId] = to`, `_balances[from] -= 1`, `_balances[to] += 1`, `_tokenApprovals[tokenId] = address(0)`), emits `Transfer(from, to, tokenId)`, and returns after the no-op `to.code.length > 0` check in `ERC721Utils.checkOnERC721Received`.
